user.title: Add a BrightSign player
user.description: Enter the player's IP address. The password is the local Diagnostic Web Server (DWS) password (user is always "admin"; factory default is the serial number). Leave it empty if the player has no password or no DWS.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the BrightSign player.
data_description.password: Local DWS password. Needed for model, uptime, HDMI status, reboot and CEC control on players with the DWS REST API.

discovery_confirm.title: BrightSign player found
discovery_confirm.description: A BrightSign player was found at {host}. Enter its local DWS password if it has one.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the DWS password
reauth_confirm.description: The BrightSign player at {host} rejected the stored DWS password, or its HTTPS certificate changed (firmware update or factory reset). Enter the password to continue; the current certificate is then trusted.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the player. Check the IP address and that the player is on.
error.invalid_auth: The player rejected this DWS password.

send_udp.name: Send UDP command
send_udp.description: Sends a UDP message, e.g. to trigger a UDP input event in a BrightAuthor presentation.

host.name: Host
host.description: IP address of the player, or a broadcast address such as 255.255.255.255.

port.name: Port
port.description: UDP receiver port of the presentation (default 5000).

message.name: Message
message.description: The UDP command text as defined in the presentation.
